objections.claim: A mutable module singleton cannot preserve per-request role isolation across overlapping requests.
objections.evidence: HOW sets module-level currentRoles on request entry and makes every downstream helper read that global.
objections.predicted_consequence: If request B enters before request A finishes its fan-out, A's later helpers read B's roles instead of A's roles. The cache must be scoped to the request before build.
